headword: {新興住宅地|しんこうじゅうたくち}
reading: しんこうじゅうたくち
gloss: newly developed residential area; new housing development

definitions.gloss: newly developed residential area; new housing development
definitions.explanation: A residential area that has been newly built, typically on the outskirts of a city, with rows of modern houses and young families as residents.

examples.japanese: {新興住宅地|しんこうじゅうたくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in a newly developed residential area.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新興住宅地|しんこうじゅうたくち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{若|わか}い⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This area is a new housing development, and there are a lot of young families.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{十五分|じゅうごふん}ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新興住宅地|しんこうじゅうたくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We decided to build a house in a new residential area about fifteen minutes by car from the station.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{新興|しんこう}→新興：00457_shinkou⟧ (newly risen, emerging), ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧ (housing), and {地|ち} (area, ground). {新興住宅地|しんこうじゅうたくち} typically refers to suburban neighborhoods that were farmland or undeveloped land a generation or two ago and have been built up with rows of single-family houses. These areas are often characterized by similar-looking homes, young populations, new schools, and a relative lack of long-established shops.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新興住宅地|しんこうじゅうたくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live in a new housing development
- {新興住宅地|しんこうじゅうたくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to develop a new residential area
- {新興住宅地|しんこうじゅうたくち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: new housing developments spread out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{住宅街|じゅうたくがい}→住宅街：09394_juutakugai⟧: residential district — any residential area, not necessarily new
- ⟦ニュータウン→ニュータウン：23077_nyuutaun⟧: new town — a large-scale planned residential development, often including commercial and public facilities
